## What

<!-- One topic per PR. What changes and why. -->

## Type
- [ ] docs / research
- [ ] design / brand
- [ ] feat (component or crate)
- [ ] fix
- [ ] chore / ci

## Component checklist (skip for docs)
- [ ] All agent states covered (idle → … → done / error / cancelled / stalled)
- [ ] Reduced-motion fallback
- [ ] Keyboard + screen-reader labels
- [ ] Light and dark tokens
- [ ] Variant names follow `docs/variants.md`

## Co-author checklist
- [ ] Every commit ends with a `Co-authored-by:` trailer for the other maintainer
- [ ] Trailer email is linked to their GitHub account
- [ ] Merge with **Create a merge commit** (or keep all trailers in the squash message)

## Licensing
- [ ] No code copied from non-MIT/Apache sources (see `docs/licensing.md`)
